injected_http_401.claim: Actual native HTTP 401 failure projects Failed without successful completion or REVIEW movement. Owned loopback-only endpoint; no real account fault claimed.

injected_http_429.claim: Actual native HTTP 429 failure projects Failed without successful completion or REVIEW movement. Owned loopback-only endpoint; no real account fault claimed.

genuine_mcp_elicitation_cancel.claim: Native Escape returns actual MCP action=cancel without accepted content; the same turn handles refusal and completes.

native_crash_exact_recovery.claim: Hard daemon restart and native quit/wake retain exact history; inner-server loss preserves unverified cleanup until explicit local risk acknowledgement resumes the same thread with retained evidence.

native_command_refusal.claim: Visible native No refuses the exact command, leaves the owned target absent and interrupts the same turn without REVIEW movement. This CLI maps No to cancel, not a separate Deny RPC; nested command item is not retained in reconstructed code-mode history.

preselection_startup_retry.claim: An owned first-launch failure retains positive before-selection evidence; explicit local acknowledgment retries into actual native Codex on the same seat after the project switches to Claude. No user turn or conversation replacement.

automatic_compaction.claim: At a verified private 14K total-context threshold, one native tool result triggers automatic compaction inside the same task. Checkout remains held through auto Pre/PostCompact and moves to REVIEW only after the subsequent real reply.
automatic_compaction.limitation: Reduced fixture threshold; the default context window was not exhausted.
